fb_text:
I run a commercial plant service in Atlanta. My new guy never calls me anymore.

That's how I knew this was working. First week with a new hire used to mean five calls a day. Gate codes. Access notes. "Which one in the lobby?" All of it lived in my head.

Now he texts a note between stops, the same way he'd text me. FieldNotes files it under the right client. When he needs a gate code, he asks the bot. My phone stays in my pocket.

I still run 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area on it. Built it for my own route. Still use it every day.
